# Amazon Developer
> Official developer portal for Amazon APIs, SDKs, tools, and technical resources across Amazon services and devices.

Amazon Developer provides documentation, APIs, SDK references, tutorials, and program information for building integrations with Amazon marketplaces, Alexa, Fire TV, Appstore, Login with Amazon, and related Amazon platforms.

## Core Documentation
- [Documentation Home](https://developer.amazon.com/docs): Entry point for Amazon developer documentation across products and platforms.
- [Developer Home](https://developer.amazon.com/): Main portal for Amazon developer tools, programs, and technical resources.
- [Developer Blog](https://developer.amazon.com/blogs): Product updates, announcements, tutorials, and engineering guidance from Amazon Developer.
- [Support](https://developer.amazon.com/support): Support resources, contact options, and help for Amazon developer programs.
- [Developer Console](https://developer.amazon.com/apps-and-games/console): Console for managing apps, skills, and Amazon developer assets.

## Alexa
- [Alexa Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa): Overview of Alexa developer tools, docs, and platform capabilities.
- [Alexa Skills Kit Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/ask-overviews/build-skills-with-the-alexa-skills-kit.html): Introduction to building voice experiences with the Alexa Skills Kit.
- [Alexa Voice Service Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-voice-service/overview.html): Build Alexa directly into products using Alexa Voice Service.
- [Alexa Smart Home Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/smarthome/understand-the-smart-home-skill-api.html): Reference and guides for smart home skill integrations.
- [Alexa Presentation Language](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-presentation-language/apl-overview.html): Build multimodal Alexa experiences with visual interfaces.
- [Alexa Developer Console](https://developer.amazon.com/alexa/console/ask): Console for creating, testing, and publishing Alexa skills.

## Appstore and Apps
- [Appstore Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/app-submission/overview.html): Guides for building, testing, and submitting apps to Amazon Appstore.
- [App Submission API](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/app-submission-api/overview.html): API documentation for automating app submission and release workflows.
- [In-App Purchasing](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/in-app-purchasing/iap-overview.html): Implement digital purchases and subscriptions in Amazon apps.
- [App Testing Service](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/app-testing-service/ats-overview.html): Test Android apps for compatibility with Amazon devices and Appstore requirements.
- [Reporting API](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/reports-promo/reporting-api.html): Access app sales, earnings, and performance reporting programmatically.
- [Small Business Accelerator Program](https://developer.amazon.com/apps-and-games/small-business-program): Program details for Appstore revenue share incentives.

## Fire TV
- [Fire TV Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/fire-tv/getting-started-developing-apps-and-games-for-fire-tv.html): Getting started guides for building apps and games for Fire TV.
- [Fire TV Design and UX](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/fire-tv/design-and-user-experience-guidelines.html): Design guidance and UX best practices for Fire TV apps.
- [Fire TV Remote Input](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/fire-tv/remote-input.html): Handle remote control navigation and input events correctly.
- [Media Playback on Fire TV](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/fire-tv/media-players.html): Implement media playback and player integration on Fire TV.
- [Testing on Fire TV](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/fire-tv/testing-your-app-on-amazon-fire-tv.html): Test and validate Fire TV apps before release.

## Login with Amazon
- [Login with Amazon Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/login-with-amazon/documentation-overview.html): Overview of authentication and authorization with Login with Amazon.
- [Web Authorization](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/login-with-amazon/web-docs.html): Integrate Login with Amazon into browser-based applications.
- [iOS SDK Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/login-with-amazon/ios-sdk-reference.html): Reference for integrating Login with Amazon on iOS.
- [Android SDK Documentation](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/login-with-amazon/android-sdk-reference.html): Reference for integrating Login with Amazon on Android.
- [Customer Profile API](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/login-with-amazon/customer-profile.html): Retrieve customer profile information after successful authorization.
- [Token Exchange and Security](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/login-with-amazon/access-token.html): Understand access tokens and secure API access patterns.

## Selling Partner API
- [Selling Partner API Home](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/sp-api/): Documentation hub for Amazon Selling Partner API resources.
- [SP-API Developer Guide](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/sp-api/guide-to-selling-partner-api.html): Core concepts, onboarding, and usage guidance for SP-API.
- [SP-API Reference](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/sp-api/reference/reference.html): API reference for orders, listings, reports, feeds, and more.
- [SP-API Models](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/sp-api/models.html): OpenAPI models and schemas for Selling Partner API endpoints.
- [SP-API Release Notes](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/sp-api/release-notes.html): Track changes, updates, and deprecations across SP-API.
- [SP-API Sandbox](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/sp-api/sandbox.html): Learn how to test integrations using sandbox environments.

## Amazon Ads API
- [Amazon Ads API Documentation](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us): Documentation for building integrations with Amazon Ads APIs.
- [Amazon Ads API Reference](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/reference/): Endpoint reference for campaign, reporting, and audience operations.
- [Amazon Ads API Guides](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/guides/): Guides for authentication, workflows, and implementation patterns.
- [Amazon Ads API Release Notes](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/release-notes/): Updates and changes to Amazon Ads API capabilities.
- [Amazon Ads API Onboarding](https://advertising.amazon.com/API/docs/en-us/get-started/overview): Get started with access, setup, and first API calls.

## Devices and Smart Home
- [Smart Home Skill API](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/device-apis/smart-home-general-apis.html): Device API guidance for Alexa smart home integrations.
- [Alexa Connect Kit](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/connected-products/alexa-connect-kit): Build connected devices with managed connectivity and Alexa integration.
- [AVS Device SDK](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/alexa-voice-service/alexa-voice-service-overview.html): SDK and documentation for embedding Alexa in hardware products.
- [Frustration-Free Setup](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/smarthome/frustration-free-setup.html): Enable simplified device setup experiences for customers.
- [Matter on Alexa](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/smarthome/matter-support.html): Guidance for Matter-compatible smart home device integrations.

## Tools and SDKs
- [Developer Tools](https://developer.amazon.com/tools-and-resources): Overview of Amazon developer tools, SDKs, and integration resources.
- [Appstore SDKs](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/app-submission/sdk-overview.html): SDK-related resources for Amazon Appstore app development.
- [Alexa Skills Kit SDKs](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/sdk/alexa-skills-kit-sdks.html): SDK options for building Alexa skills in multiple languages.
- [Alexa Hosted Skills](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs/alexa/hosted-skills/alexa-hosted-skills-overview.html): Managed hosting option for Alexa skill development and deployment.
- [Developer Downloads](https://developer.amazon.com/apps-and-games/resources/developer-tools): Downloadable tools and utilities for Amazon app development.

## Guides and Learning
- [Tutorials and Training](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/alexa/alexa-skills-kit/get-deeper/tutorials-code-samples): Tutorials and code samples for Alexa and related developer workflows.
- [Code Samples](https://developer.amazon.com/en-US/docs): Product documentation with embedded examples and implementation guidance.
- [App Distribution and Promotion](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/reports-promo/promote-apps.html): Learn how to promote and grow apps on Amazon platforms.
- [Monetization Guides](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/in-app-purchasing/monetizing-your-app.html): Guidance for monetization using in-app purchasing and subscriptions.
- [Publishing Best Practices](https://developer.amazon.com/docs/app-submission/device-targeting-and-compatibility.html): Best practices for compatibility, targeting, and successful app publishing.
